if (pm.response.code < 300) { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.test("claimId returned",()=>pm.expect(d.claimId).to.be.a("string")); if(d.claimId) pm.environment.set("claimId",d.claimId); }

pm.test("Response data correct",()=>{const d=pm.response.json(); const n=d.find(x=>x.type==="new_claim" && (x.listing._id || x.listing)===pm.environment.get("listingId")); pm.expect(n).to.exist; pm.expect(n.isRead).to.eql(false);});

pm.test("Response data correct",()=>{const d=pm.response.json(); const n=d.find(x=>x.type==="claim_withdrawn" && (x.listing._id || x.listing)===pm.environment.get("listingId")); pm.expect(n).to.exist; pm.expect(n.isRead).to.eql(false);});

pm.test("Response data correct",()=>{const d=pm.response.json(); const n=d.find(x=>x.type==="claim_confirmed" && (x.listing._id || x.listing)===pm.environment.get("listingId")); pm.expect(n).to.exist; pm.expect(n.isRead).to.eql(false);});

pm.test("Response data correct",()=>{const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.collectionLocation.coordinates).to.eql([-9.1295,38.7115]); pm.expect(d.collectionInstructions).to.eql("QA pickup instructions");});

pm.test("Response data correct",()=>{const d=pm.response.json(); const n=d.find(x=>x.type==="gift_completed" && (x.listing._id || x.listing)===pm.environment.get("listingId")); pm.expect(n).to.exist; pm.expect(n.isRead).to.eql(false); pm.environment.set("notificationId",n._id);});
